draft.subject: Re: Anything I can help with?
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Great to hear the first project is starting to click — thanks for the update after our call last week.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the natural next step is bringing in whoever will be working alongside you: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Want me to walk you through that first invite on a 15-minute call this week? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Priya
